top_story_title: Cisco ships October Node.js fixes, including the KEV-listed Brotli decoder flaw CVE-2026-111497
top_story_summary: Cisco PSIRT published advisory cisco-sa-oct2026-node-js-Jj3SQ19u on 2 November, covering the Node.js security release of 21 October 2026 for the 22.x, 24.x and 26.x lines. Four of the vulnerabilities carry a Cisco Security Impact Rating of High: CVE-2026-111497, an out-of-bounds write in the Brotli decoder with potential remote code execution; CVE-2026-105482, DNS resolution truncation involving embedded NUL characters; and CVE-2026-105483 and CVE-2026-106069, two TLS hostname validation bypasses - one using fullwidth IP digits, the other noncanonical IP addresses.
top_actions: Open advisory cisco-sa-oct2026-node-js-Jj3SQ19u, take the affected-product table, and match it against your Cisco asset inventory by model and running version - check the vendor advisory for the fixed release rather than assuming a build.
Treat CVE-2026-111497 as the deadline item: CISA KEV lists it as added 2026-10-27 with a remediation date of 2026-11-10, so federal and KEV-aligned programmes have days, not a quarter.

Prioritise any affected device or management host that terminates untrusted traffic or accepts internet-sourced compressed responses, since the Brotli path is reachable pre-authentication according to CISA's description.
Remove management access (HTTPS/SSH/API) from untrusted and internet-facing interfaces on affected devices now, as the standing control that holds while upgrades are scheduled.

For the TLS hostname validation bypasses, verify which management, syslog, federation and cloud-callback connections on affected devices rely on certificate hostname checks, and pin or restrict those destinations until patched.
executive_summary: Cisco's October Node.js advisory is the lead: four High-rated flaws in Cisco products, one of them CVE-2026-111497, a Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write that CISA added to KEV on 2026-10-27 with a 2026-11-10 remediation date.
Two of the four are TLS hostname validation bypasses, which fail silently - affected devices may accept certificates they should reject on management and federation connections.
The advisory as collected names no affected products or fixed builds; pull the affected-product table from Cisco directly rather than assuming a version.
Synology is warning of ransomware crews encrypting NAS devices still running DSM builds older than its December 2024 fix - an already-patched flaw being used against unpatched edge storage.

AI shows up on both sides this cycle: LLM-directed intrusion campaigns hitting 200+ organisations in 11 days, Check Point's "prompt adware" persisting through an agent's trusted instruction files, and Cisco announcing AI Transit to extend SD-WAN policy to AI cloud environments.
Quiet cycle for new network-device CVEs otherwise - no exploited firewall, VPN or router zero-day in this window.
key_actions: **Cisco** — Retrieve the affected-product table from cisco-sa-oct2026-node-js-Jj3SQ19u and filter your asset inventory by model and running version; check the vendor advisory for the fixed release rather than assuming a build number.
**Cisco** — Schedule the upgrade against the KEV remediation date of 2026-11-10 for CVE-2026-111497, not the normal quarterly cycle; upgrade HA pair secondaries first, fail over, then the primary.

headlines.title: Vulnerabilities in Node.js Affecting Cisco Products: October 2026
headlines.summary: Cisco's October Node.js advisory covers four high-severity flaws in Cisco products, including KEV-listed Brotli decoder bug CVE-2026-111497 that can reach remote code execution.

headlines.title: Synology NAS Devices Targeted in Ransomware Attacks Exploiting Patched DSM Flaw
headlines.summary: Synology is urging DSM updates after seeing ransomware crews encrypt NAS devices still running builds older than a fix it shipped in December 2024.

headlines.title: Fireperf: Open-source network testing tool for firewalls and routers
headlines.summary: The IPFire project released fireperf, an open-source tool that opens connections at a fixed rate to measure how stateful firewalls and routers cope with per-connection state.

headlines.title: AI agents scale and speed up Chinese-linked attacks
headlines.summary: CrowdStrike and Kaspersky describe China-linked campaigns where an LLM picks the commands, one of them reaching more than 200 organisations in 11 days.

headlines.title: PHP2Shell: How Cisco Helps Customers Respond to AI-Accelerated Threats
headlines.summary: Cisco published its customer-facing coverage and resilience guidance for PHP2Shell, framing it as an AI-accelerated threat rather than a one-off.

headlines.title: Cisco AI Transit connects AI environments to your SD-WAN
headlines.summary: Cisco AI Transit extends the existing SD-WAN fabric to AI cloud environments so network teams keep one policy model for AI-bound traffic.
